title: Lights Out! A game of combinatorics and linear algebra
summary: In this work, we study a triangular variant of the Lights Out game, proposed in the 2025 Capixaba Mathematics Olympiad. We present a combinatorial description of the game, formally characterize its operations, and introduce the notion of a quiet pattern, which determines which configurations admit a solution and how many solutions they possess. We then analyze the geometry of quiet patterns and describe the propagation mechanisms that generate patterns for larger board sizes.
